svg.title: Current definitions and independent factual histories
svg.desc: Definitions and state edit current content. Evidence supersession and actual run records retain immutable facts; Git owns content history.
svg.text: Current definitions and independent factual histories
Definitions and state edit current content. Evidence supersession and actual run records retain immutable facts;

g.text: Current lifecycle state
The current state obeys allowed transitions and activation
prerequisites; retired is terminal. A state edit does not append
a second Saga content history.
Current definition
One current.json contains complete definition and state.
Independent records merge separately; edits to the same file use
normal Git conflicts.
Evidence supersession
Evidence records remain immutable and explicitly supersede
earlier records. An eligible head must pin the current
definition digest.
Actual run history
Compatibility runs remain immutable facts with explicit parent
heads; conflicts and result literals remain historical, outside
definition coverage.
Git conflicts and legacy ambiguity
Git handles concurrent edits of current files. Ambiguous legacy
definitions stop normalization without selecting a winner or
deleting authored candidates.

svg.text: Stable identities · exact evidence pins · Git-owned committed history
